Create a golang cli that allows me to calculate AWS ROSA HCP costs. In this calculator i'd like to be able to do hourly, monthly, annual and 1 and 3 year committed cost planning for red hat and aws infrastructure such as reserved instances and 1 and 3 year commitments. I'd like this calculator to use AWS APIs to get real time costs and be able to present the cost model to the user on screen and output machine readable json/yaml as well as a well formatted markdown file with the cost estimate. This tool should consider the ability to add additional machine pools, resume from the machine readable json of prior runs to add/modify machine pools or capability and output a new file accordingly.
